verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a single unified API covering payments, capture, payouts, refunds, Pix returns, chargebacks, balances and settlement history, plus webhook notifications and in-reference request sending. That means much of the core money movement is API-accessible. However, there is no stated API/UI parity commitment, and payment links are described as created via the dashboard, with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: an explicit claim that all dashboard functionality is exposed via the API, evidence that dashboard-only features like payment links and chargeback responses are API-accessible, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.
